branches.scope: Existing whole TerminalTest. Helper tasks only exercise the finite owner-mismatch method boundary and relay throwable to the synchronous independent assertion. No remote process, service, DB, native file or actual capture operations.
branches.positive: For two Thread sites both joins are capped at 5000ms and final assertion requires no live child, the independent process watchdog is maintained; no container-managed application thread contract is violated.
branches.throwable: Both catches write exactly the thrown observation to a test-owned AtomicReference and the caller verifies IOException type. A non-expected Throwable cannot produce a PASS.
